pages.text: I forgot how loud five people are.$(br2)We had the Fair today, first one in -- I want to say nine years, but Oda would correct me, and she'd be right. She keeps the book.$(br2)I set out one trestle at eight. By noon there were four.
pages.title: Entry Two

pages.text: One stall was a plank on two barrels. Pip sold flowers from my own garden and charged me for them.$(br2)Bram got the wheel turning. He put his hands on his hips and said $(italic)well$(). That is the most emotional I have ever seen that man.
Write this down somewhere you'll find it in November, when it's dark and you're tired and you're wondering why you're bothering:$(br2)$(bold)It's this.$()$(br2)It was always going to be this.
